title.en: Strict double-category certificate kernel, conservative 3D extension, and guarded oplax syntax

statement.en: With 0 axioms, Becoming.DoubleKernel proves unique 2D frame typing (T1), EqCert soundness and initiality (T2, T4, T5), conservative 3D directed extension (Lem 6, T8, T9), and Guarded Oplax Double Syntax gated by explicit Beck-Chevalley witnesses in OplaxHistory.RelSpan.

laws.en: DoubleSig square terms SqTerm have unique Frame typing (hasFrame_unique, T1); all 10 EqCert rules preserve frames and evaluate soundly and uniquely into any StrictDoubleCat (eqCert_preserves_frame T2, eqCert_sound T5, free_double_eval_unique T4), separated by natTallyDoubleCat (distinct_same_frame_gens_not_cert_eq, Cor 4.0).

Relative 3D directed modifications (Double3Sig, Cell3Term, Eq3Cert) preserve parallel 2D endpoints (cell3_eq_preserves_endpoints, Lem 6), conserve base 2D equality conservatively without collapsing distinct base cells (conservative_over_base_2d T9, strict_2d_3d_noncollapse_witness), and evaluate soundly into any StrictTripleCat (free_3d_eval_sound, T8).

GuardedExpr and GuardedProof evaluate directly into Becoming.OplaxHistory.RelSpan morphisms (evalGuardedProof, guarded_oplax_sound), restricting chiInv strictly by explicit Bij / Beck-Chevalley certificates so guarded oplax rewriting holds on EmergentCrossSeamWitness where unguarded strict interchange fails (strict_vs_guarded_separation_witness).

hypotheses.en: Constructive Lean 4 Init types with 0 axioms and 0 private declarations; 2D free initiality assumes strict double-category equations hold identically in target M, 3D modifications require parallel 2D source/target boundary frames, and GuardedProof.chiInv requires an explicit Bij witness.

does_not_show.en: Free 2D/3D initiality shows generator assignments extend uniquely modulo EqCert/Eq3Cert, never that software obeys strict interchange without guarded Beck-Chevalley checks (Rule 2).
Does not implement a decision procedure or polynomial-time normalizer for arbitrary quotiented double theories (domain equations and weak higher coherence remain unautomated).

detail.en: distinct_same_frame_gens_not_cert_eq (two parallel generators separated by natTallyDoubleCat), strict_2d_3d_noncollapse_witness (non-reversible 3D transition keeping distinct base 2D terms), and strict_vs_guarded_separation_witness (GuardedProof validity vs. failure of unguarded strict interchange on EmergentCrossSeamWitness).
